caption: The drawing depicts a wooden washing device consisting of a rectangular, reddish-brown wooden box on four slightly splayed legs. Inside the box is a central mechanism composed of a horizontally mounted rod, which holds several ribbed, beige rollers and a round, gear-like disc on each side of the rollers. The rollers and discs span the width of the box, and the rod appears to extend outside the box on either end, forming crank handles. The box itself is open at the top and the wood grain is visible, with some internal wooden slats or braces supporting the rollers and sides. Surrounding the main colored illustration, there are four lightly sketched, uncolored diagrams or schematics of parts of the device, one at each corner of the drawing. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color with faint brownish marks and borders around the edges.
title: Butter Worker
